title: Pure Ally of Justice
summary: Pure Ally of Justice paired with a compact Machina and Black Salvo DARK Machine engine and DNA Transplant. Every Ally of Justice monster punishes LIGHT monsters or face-down defenses, and DNA Transplant forces the opponent's entire board into the LIGHT Attribute.

summary.title: Starters
points: Machina Gearframe Normal Summons to search Machina Fortress, which discards high-Level Machines (such as Ally Mind) to Special Summon itself from the hand or GY.

Black Salvo is a Level 3 DARK Machine Tuner that revives a Level 4 DARK Machine in Defense Position when Normal Summoned, pulling Ally of Justice Garadholg or Core Destroyer from the GY for an instant Level 7 Synchro.
Ally of Justice Cycle Reader is a Level 3 Tuner that doubles as a handtrap against LIGHT decks, discarding itself to banish up to 2 LIGHT monsters from the opponent's GY.

summary.title: Opening: Machina Gearframe + Black Salvo
steps: Normal Summon Machina Gearframe to search Machina Fortress, then discard Ally of Justice Garadholg and another Machine to Special Summon Fortress.
Set DNA Transplant to declare LIGHT at the start of the opponent's turn, turning all face-up monsters on the field into LIGHT monsters.

On the following turn, Normal Summon Black Salvo to revive Garadholg for a Level 7 Synchro, or tune Cycle Reader with a Level 5/7 body into Ally of Justice Light Gazer, Field Marshal or Decisive Armor.

summary.title: DNA Transplant & Anti-LIGHT Lock
summary.text: While DNA Transplant is face-up declaring LIGHT, every opposing monster becomes a valid target for Ally of Justice hate effects. Ally of Justice Quarantine prevents both players from Special Summoning LIGHT monsters while face-up, Core Destroyer automatically destroys any LIGHT monster at the start of the Damage Step, and Thousand Arms can attack every face-up LIGHT monster the opponent controls once each.

summary.title: Synchro Bosses
points: Ally of Justice Catastor (Level 5) automatically destroys any non-DARK monster it battles at the start of the Damage Step without damage calculation.

Ally of Justice Decisive Armor (Level 10) activates one of three anti-LIGHT effects once per turn while the opponent controls a LIGHT monster: destroy a Set card, send 1 card from hand to destroy all Spells/Traps the opponent controls, or send your entire hand to look at the opponent's hand, send all LIGHT monsters in it to the GY, and burn equal to their combined ATK.
Ally of Justice Field Marshal (Level 9) draws a card whenever it destroys a Defense Position monster by battle, and Light Gazer (Level 8) gains 200 ATK per LIGHT monster in the opponent's GY.

allow.Black Salvo: Level 3 DARK Machine Tuner that revives a Level 4 DARK Machine like Garadholg for an instant Level 7 Synchro.
allow.Machina Gearframe: Searches Machina Fortress and provides reliable Machine Normal Summon presence.
allow.Machina Fortress: Discards high-level Ally of Justice monsters to Special Summon itself as Synchro fodder or beatdown.
allow.DNA Transplant: Continuous Trap that changes all monsters on the field to LIGHT, enabling all Ally of Justice anti-LIGHT effects.
